item.title: [KYLIN-5311] Improve performance of getSubstitutor
item.description:
Fix Design

参考

KYLIN-5274 Improve performance of getSubstitutor - ASF JIRA

  1. 将substitutor缓存，不重复初始化
  1. 增加CompositeMapView {} 来同时支持properties和system env
  1. 增加ICachedExternalConfigLoader 接口，来标识不可变properties
